Curated research repository comparing PDF/OCR-to-Markdown extraction pipelines, including open-source tools, proprietary APIs, specialized VLMs, and general multimodal models. Aggregates benchmark results, capabilities, licenses, API availability, and deployment trade-offs to support technical evaluation of document processing stacks.

FastAPI-based embedding server and Python client for retrieval systems. Provides dense, sparse, and BGE-M3 embeddings in a single request with efficient transport via base64-encoded vectors and gzip-compressed requests/responses. Also supports client-side caching and integration with rerankers/CrossEncoders.

Local-first, cross-platform desktop application for labeling computer vision datasets without accounts, cloud uploads, or external storage. Built with Electron, SolidJS, and SQLite, it provides fast image and mask rendering through preloading and WebGL shaders, streamlined keyboard-driven workflows, and AI-assisted annotation using SAM-HQ, SAM 3, and SAM 2.1.

CookieCutter-based starter for building FastAPI applications with uv. It supports PostgreSQL with SQLAlchemy or MongoDB with Beanie for databases, integrates Ruff for formatting and linting, and enables deployment with Docker and GitHub Actions. It also includes TUI for adding new routers and generating boilerplate code.

Python library that extends FastAPI by automatically generating OpenAPI responses based on your endpoint's source code. This plugin helps you reduce boilerplate code by deriving response statuses and descriptions directly from your code.

Plugin that patches the FastAPI app to include a latest Swagger UI distribution. Also, it works locally and does not depend on the @tiangolo domains and CDNs. It updates automatically on each Swagger UI release.

A utility for FastAPI that simplifies the creation of mock endpoints during development. It allows returning generated examples instead of HTTP 500. Examples are based on response models. Advanced features include JSON schema examples, field examples and defaults, and support for custom example providers such as Faker.
